description: This file defines a controller class 'PurgeCandidateController' within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the purging candidates functionality in the maintenance plugin. It extends a base Vue controller, implements an admin privilege interface, and uses traits for authentication, administrative access, and configuration services. The class includes methods for pre-render setup and request handling, ensuring only authorized users can perform actions.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling purge candidate operations within the maintenance plugin, ensuring only authorized admin users can invoke the functionality.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component 'purge-candidate' with the instance identifier property obtained from configuration service.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, verifying admin access before proceeding with the parent handle method, or forwarding to an admin access page if unauthorized.
